verdicts.reason: A: the top is jammed. The ALL AGES pill sits above the headline, the date comes before the subhead, and SOLSTICE PRESENTS has slipped below the URL. The RSVP button is the same size as the FREE ENTRY and TASTINGS pills, so the CTA does not stand out, and a large 'missing asset' placeholder fills the footer. B: the headline and top spacing are better, but the badges are scattered (TASTINGS above the title, ALL AGES floating in the middle). The RSVP CTA is shrunk to a tiny button, smaller than FREE ENTRY, and crammed beside a missing-asset box that is cut off at the canvas edge. That buries the main action, so B is the worse of the two.
